§l3.1.0 | 1.19.4 - 26.3 (2026/08/19)
§7- After testing, I noticed that the datapack was compatible with 1.19.4! But there's no way it could be compatible with older versions. So it's official: the supported versions are: 1.19.4 -> Forever (I hope)
- Added a condition for "global" sitting for consistency
- Added a confirmation window when you click on "uninstall" in the dialogs
- Completed the transition to make the datapack fully translatable. EVERYTHING is now supported.
- Now with translations in French, Spanish, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese!
The translation may be inaccurate as I only speak English and French. If you notice any errors, please let me know!
If you would like to translate this project into your own language, feel free to create the translation file and send it to me!

§l3.0.0 | 1.20 - 26.3 (2026/08/17)
§7§l# QUALITY OF LIFE
§7- Added uninstall method (/function sitanywhere:-uninstall)
§7- Added settings (/function sitanywhere:-settings)
§7- Added dialog menus! (1.21.6+) Accessible via the pause menu. You will find infos about the datapack version, supported MC versions, settings, changelog, links and uninstall button
§7- Added translatability! However, it only supports English for now.
§7- Made compatible from 1.20 to 26.3 with only ONE datapack! - 3 years of version support B-) 
§7§l# BUG FIXES & TECHNICAL CHANGES
§7- Fixed for 26.3
§7- Rewriten the whole datapack to have better naming, files, ...
§7- Small optimisation changes in all selectors
§7- Changed player position when sitting: now always sit on top of the block and not a little inside
§7- Removed all advancement icons in 1.21.6+, all infos are in the new dialog menus
§7- Removed changelog from advancements in all versions, you'll only be able to see it in 1.21.6+ with the new dialog menus

§f§l2.3.5 | 1.21 - 26.2 (2026/06/20)§7
§7- Fixed for 26.2
§7- Added changelog to advancements page

§f§l2.3.4 | 1.21.x (2025/09/04)§7
§7- Made the loading message appear only if you have the tag "convention.debug"
§7- Moved the datapack's advancements icons to the community's convention tab.

§f§l2.3.3 | 1.21.x (2025/08/18)§7
§7- Reworked overlays (now that i understand them properly...)

§f§l2.3.1b | 1.21.x (2025/05/16)§7
§7- The mod version was not working for Fabric and Quilt.

§f§l2.3.1 | 1.21.x (2025/05/11)§7
§7- Fixed a typo I made in previous update...
§7- And the sit command was broken.
§7- Added conditions to use sit command

§f§l2.3.0 | 1.21.x (2025/05/11)§7
§7- Fixed a bug that spawned infinite interactions
§7- Fixed a bug where you could "sit" on stair while already sitting on a global sit. Which does not work and spawn useless entities
§7- Added "/trigger sit" command!

§f§l2.2.1 (2025/04/11)§7
§7- Now only works with "bottom stairs" only... yeah a feeling of deja vu, isn't it?
§7- Removed - message for slabs and stairs "Right Click to sit" because I found it annoying

§f§l2.2.0 (2025/04/03)§7
§l# QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE
§7- You now have to double sneak to activate global sit ! (was often interfering while building)
§7- You now have to look between X-rot 85 and 90 to be able to sit (was 90 only) so it's less restrictive/frustrating
§7- Reduced hitbox of interaction entity a bit so other players can place block on the side of the one you're standing on
§l# BUG FIXES & MISSING FEATURES
§7- Fixed - other players could use your interaction entity to sit on the block you're standing on when they are not themselves on the same block as you
§7- Fixed - "right click to sit" message was sent to near players
§7- Fixed - apparition and removal of interaction entities
§7- Removed - useless function
§7- Added - new message for slabs and stairs "Right Click to sit" instead of "Unhold Sneak and Right Click to Sit" like for global sitting

§f§l2.1.1 (2025/03/30)§7
§7- Now only works with "bottom slabs" only

§f§l2.1.0 (2025/03/30)§7
§7- Added easy sit on stairs and slabs (just stand and right click on them)
§7- Added a small message to indicate you can rightclick to sit
§7- Fixed - issue when leaving your seat by mounting another entity

§f§l2.0.0 (2025/02/21)§7
§7- Rewrited the datapack to make it easier to update. But縫 made it incompatible with older version.
§7- Minecraft updates have broken the background of the advancements list.
§7- Correction of the seating position, as all MC versions modify it slightly.

§f§l1.1.2 (2025/01/19)§7
§7- Fixed a bug that allowed you to sit up in the air by breaking the block below you.

§f§l1.1.0 (2023/07/14)§7
§7- Removed useless function
§7- Fixed a bug that somehow made the datapack multiplayer incompatible

§f§l1.0.1 (2023/03/25)§7
§7- Added version number in the icon's description in the SozoKa's advancement tab.
§7- Fix : SozoKa's head (main icon) was broken in the SozoKa's advancement tab.
